# Support

If you need help with Receipts, please check the following resources:

## 📖 Documentation
Check the [Wiki](https://github.com/fam007e/receipts/wiki) and [README](README.md).

## 🐛 Issue Tracker
If you found a bug or have a feature request, please [open an issue](https://github.com/fam007e/receipts/issues).

For general questions or discussions, please use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/fam007e/receipts/discussions).

## ✉️ Direct Contact
